title: 09 / Membrane: Infinite
sub: Another telling of 09 / Membrane, wide, on a mountain's summit torn up and floating in the void: two strokes, then the great one, her arm driving on through it. Time all but stops as it lands and stays slowed to the end; the hide turns to glass on an ocean's way down without end, and our universe's membrane tears open on a deep of its own, strands of light and of dark out to forever. 24 seconds at 1920×1080, WebGPU, the drum's sound simulated from its own physics.

title: 04 / Gyre
sub: Forty glazed hoops, each one flipping over twice a loop, starting from the outside. A seamless 16-second loop, sphere-traced in WebGPU.
